entities.name: A2R989
observations: Sequence matches reviewed Aspergillus niger probable beta-glucosidase I at 100% identity and 100% query coverage (query_protein homology result).
Reference annotation describes a probable beta-glucosidase involved in releasing glucose from cellobiose during cellulose degradation; function is noted as by similarity.
Reference localization is secreted; associated GO annotations include extracellular region, beta-glucosidase activity, and cellulose catabolic process.
Query sequence contains Glyco_hydro_3 and Glyco_hydro_3_C Pfam domains; PA14 and Fn3-like domains are also detected.

entities.name: Cellulose degradation
observations: Reviewed reference annotations associate the probable beta-glucosidase with cellulose degradation and glycan metabolism; substrate-level role is annotated by similarity.
